# I - Governance

## When to Use
- Updating PRDs or technical documentation
- Recording architectural or business decisions
- Auditing traceability between docs and code

## Procedure
1. Review the objective and context of the change.
2. Record decisions, impacts, and rationale.
3. Validate consistency with code and pipeline behavior.
4. Document risks, assumptions, and next steps.

## Standards
- Keep documentation aligned with implementation.
- Always surface risks and pending decisions.
